title: Giving up drinking in 1969 and smoking in 1935
summary: Waters quit drinking in 1969 after losing his appetite and quit smoking around 1935, leaving overwork as his only vice.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: You said, you frequently said over the last few years that you gave up drinking ten years ago, but -
Well, a little bit more than ten years ago -
It must be ten now. 'Cause the first time you told me, this time must be -
I tell you when, exactly when it was - 1969, so you can figure yourself.
It was ten years ago the first time you told me, yeah.
Yeah. Well, I told you it was ten years ago.
Well, I gave up drinkin' on account of I couldn't eat, I [was] just losing appetite and going without food for two or three days all in New York, you know -
Working every night, though. That's the bad part.

That's exactly why I gave up drinking. I gave up smoking right here in New York, right down at the same place where I was, this dancing school right - which is 46th, used to be 46th and Broadway, upstairs. I gave up smoking there and that was in 1935 or something like that. Oh, yeah, around that time - no, no, yeah, yeah, around that time period. And I haven't smoked a cigarette since -
Probably your only remaining vice is that you work too hard, huh? (laughs)
Work too hard sometimes at night (both laugh). I need to correct that too.
